boundary.setup:
CREATE TABLE orders AS SELECT * FROM (VALUES
  (1, TIMESTAMP '2025-12-31 23:59:00', 75.00, 'completed'),
  (2, TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00', 120.00, 'completed'),
  (3, TIMESTAMP '2026-01-12 19:45:00', 95.50, 'completed'),
  (4, TIMESTAMP '2026-01-18 11:30:00', 140.00, 'completed'),
  (5, TIMESTAMP '2026-01-22 16:10:00', 33.25, 'cancelled'),
  (6, TIMESTAMP '2026-01-31 00:00:00', 50.00, 'completed'),
  (7, TIMESTAMP '2026-01-31 09:15:00', 310.00, 'completed'),
  (8, TIMESTAMP '2026-01-31 18:40:00', 125.00, 'completed'),
  (9, TIMESTAMP '2026-02-01 00:00:00', 99.00, 'completed')
) AS t(order_id, order_ts, amount, status);

table.sql: SELECT order_id, order_ts, amount, status FROM orders ORDER BY order_id;

page.sql:
SELECT
  SUM(amount) FILTER (
    WHERE order_ts
      BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-01-31'
  ) AS assistant_total,
  SUM(amount) FILTER (
    WHERE order_ts >= '2026-01-01'
      AND order_ts < '2026-02-01'
  ) AS half_open_total
FROM orders
WHERE status = 'completed';

kept.sql:
SELECT order_id, order_ts, amount, status,
  order_ts BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-01-31' AS assistant,
  order_ts >= '2026-01-01' AND order_ts < '2026-02-01' AS half_open
FROM orders
ORDER BY order_id;

assistant.sql:
SELECT SUM(amount) AS january_revenue
FROM orders
WHERE status = 'completed'
  AND order_ts BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-01-31';

halfOpen.sql:
SELECT SUM(amount) AS january_revenue
FROM orders
WHERE status = 'completed'
  AND order_ts >= '2026-01-01' AND order_ts < '2026-02-01';

cutoff.sql: SELECT CAST('2026-01-31' AS TIMESTAMP) AS upper_bound;

lastSecond.sql:
SELECT
  CAST(t AS VARCHAR) AS order_ts,
  t BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-01-31 23:59:59' AS to_last_second,
  t >= '2026-01-01' AND t < '2026-02-01' AS half_open
FROM (SELECT TIMESTAMP '2026-01-31 23:59:59.5' AS t);
